title_ar: الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو يشارك في المؤتمر العالمي للإسلام بالعاصمة الروسية موسكو
title_en: Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Takes Part in the World Conference on Islam in the Russian Capital, Moscow
body_ar: شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء ورئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين في المؤتمر العالمي لعلماء الإسلام المنعقد بالعاصمة الروسية موسكو في الفترة بين 25 مايو إلى 29 مايو 2012م، تحت شعار "الفكر الإسلامي ودوره في مواجهة الغلو"، وهو المؤتمر الذي نظمه كل من المركز العالمي للوسطية بدولة الكويت والمركز الروسي للوسطية بموسكو بالتعاون مع الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين، وبمساعدة جمعية بطل روسيا أحمد قادروف الخيرية الاجتماعية الإقليمية، والجمعية الخيرية لدعم الثقافة الإسلامية والعلوم والتعليم. وقد ألقي فضيلة الشيخ الددو مداخلة في اليوم الثاني من المؤتمر بعنوان: "فقه الولاء والبراء ودوره في ترسيخ المواطنة". ويشارك مع الشيخ في هذا المؤتمر كوكبة من علماء المسلمين من شتى أنحاء العالم. وسينشر الموقع بمشيئة الله مشاركة الشيخ في المؤتمر لاحقا.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and president of Abdullah ibn Yasin University, took part in the World Conference of the Scholars of Islam, convened in the Russian capital, Moscow, in the period from 25 May to 29 May 2012, under the banner "Islamic Thought and Its Role in Confronting Going to Excess in Religion". The conference was organised by the International Centre for Moderation in the State of Kuwait together with the Russian Centre for Moderation in Moscow, in cooperation with the International Union of Muslim Scholars, and with the assistance of the Regional Social Charitable Foundation "Hero of Russia Akhmad Kadyrov" and the Charitable Foundation for the Support of Islamic Culture, Science and Education.

Sheikh al-Dedew delivered an intervention on the second day of the conference entitled "The Jurisprudence of Loyalty and Disavowal and Its Role in Entrenching Citizenship". A constellation of Muslim scholars from every part of the world is taking part with the Sheikh in this conference. The site will, God willing, publish the Sheikh's contribution to the conference at a later date.

flags.arabic: فقه الولاء والبراء ودوره في ترسيخ المواطنة
flags.context: the title of the Sheikh's intervention; no content is given
options: The Jurisprudence of Loyalty and Disavowal and Its Role in Entrenching Citizenship
The Fiqh of Allegiance and Dissociation and Its Role in Consolidating Citizenship
The Law of Loyalty and Repudiation and its Role in Establishing Citizenship
flags.note: al-walāʾ wa-l-barāʾ — loyalty to the believers and disavowal of unbelief — is among the most contested doctrines in contemporary Islamic discourse, and the claim implied by this title, that it can be squared with and even support national citizenship, is a substantial and controversial one. The corpus holds the title and nothing else: no argument, no evidence, no qualification. The doctrine is not in the glossary and should be added. A reader will take a position from the title alone; the site must not let the title stand as the argument.

flags.context: الفكر الإسلامي ودوره في مواجهة الغلو — the conference banner
flags.note: ghuluw is the Qur'anic term for overstepping the proper bounds in religion (compare Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:171) and is the word the conference chose. 'Extremism' is the usual English of political discourse, but it carries a security-policy freight the Arabic does not, and the substitution would quietly change what the conference said it was about. The longer, plainer rendering is used. Not in the glossary; should be added.

flags.arabic: المؤتمر العالمي للإسلام / المؤتمر العالمي لعلماء الإسلام
flags.context: the conference named one way in the headline and another in the body
options: render both as the source gives them
flags.note: The headline calls it the World Conference on Islam and the body the World Conference of the Scholars of Islam. Both are rendered as served; the discrepancy is the source's.

flags.context: المركز العالمي للوسطية ... والمركز الروسي للوسطية
flags.note: wasaṭiyyah, the doctrine of the middle way, taken from the Qur'anic 'a middle community' (Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:143). Here it is part of two institutions' names, so 'Moderation' is used as the form those bodies use in English. As a doctrinal term elsewhere in the corpus it will need its own glossary entry, and 'moderation' alone will not serve for it.

translator_notes: A news-desk announcement. It names the Sheikh's intervention and gives none of its content; the site's undertaking to publish it may not have been kept.
The CMS timestamp, 3 June 2012, is a bulk-upload date; the conference ran 25–29 May 2012.

The record mixes past and present tense about the same conference ('took part' at the start, 'is taking part' near the end), which suggests it was assembled from an earlier advance notice. Both tenses are preserved.
'أحمد قادروف' is Akhmad Kadyrov, the late head of the Chechen Republic; the Russian foundation bearing his name is given in its own English form.
